architectural_discrepancies.description: Database implementation uses AsyncStorage, NOT WatermelonDB
architectural_discrepancies.reality: Package @nozbe/watermelondb NOT in package.json. Using AsyncStorage key-value store instead.
architectural_discrepancies.impact: Phase 2 documentation is inaccurate. Current implementation is simpler but functional.
architectural_discrepancies.decision_needed: Keep AsyncStorage or migrate to WatermelonDB?
architectural_discrepancies.recommendation: Keep AsyncStorage if performance acceptable, otherwise plan migration.

architectural_discrepancies.documentation: Documented tables: User, Shift, Incident, Venue, ShiftCheck
architectural_discrepancies.impact: Venue and ShiftCheck data not stored locally
architectural_discrepancies.recommendation: Add missing tables if offline venue/check access needed
